# SwiftUI forms and containers references (iOS 26.5)

The iOS 26.5 set for `examples/swiftui-forms`, captured on the iPhone 17 Pro simulator with the states and steps
in [`../ios27/swiftui-forms-ios/README.md`](../ios27/swiftui-forms-ios/README.md). Only iOS 27.2 is gated; check
this set with `SIMCORE_IOS="26.5 27.2" scripts/compare-ios.sh`.
